title: The Lake House
score_note: two letters, one mailbox: the leads share a year only at the end

beats.name: THE LETTER IN THE MAILBOX
cap: kate leaves a note in 2006; two years
earlier, alex finds it and writes back

beats.name: THE PAWPRINTS
cap: alex's dog runs through the wet paint and
leaves the marks kate's note described
beats.tag: STRUCTURE — the house makes the letter true

beats.name: VALENTINE'S DAY
cap: kate fails to save a stranger struck
by a car in daley plaza
beats.tag: STRUCTURE — a death the film will return to

beats.name: TWO YEARS APART
cap: the letters cross two years in a day;
they work out they live in different ones
beats.tag: CHEMISTRY — a courtship at the speed of post

beats.name: PERSUASION
cap: kate asks alex to find the austen novel
she left behind at the train station
beats.tag: GESTURE — a book carried across two years

beats.name: THE ARCHITECTURE WALK
cap: alex maps the chicago buildings he loves;
kate walks the route two years later
beats.tag: CHEMISTRY — a date assembled out of letters

beats.name: ALEX'S FATHER
cap: alex's architect father simon is dying,
while alex restores the lake house
beats.tag: STRUCTURE — the family strand the film keeps

beats.name: THE BIRTHDAY PARTY
cap: at kate's party, thrown by morgan, alex
kisses her and says nothing of the letters
beats.tag: STRUCTURE — the one night the two years touch

beats.name: THE MAN SHE SAW
cap: kate realizes the man who died in the
road was alex, coming to meet her
beats.tag: STRUCTURE — she learns what the letters cost

beats.name: DON'T COME
cap: kate writes to stop alex crossing the
road; he obeys and waits two years
beats.tag: GESTURE — obeying a letter that saves him

beats.name: THE LAKE HOUSE, AGAIN
cap: kate comes back to the lake house and
alex is there, waiting in her own year
beats.tag: STRUCTURE — the two timelines finally meet
